items.title: Alphabet shareholder sues Sundar Pichai and 12 others over training Google's AI, including Lyria, on copyrighted works
items.excerpt: Shareholder Phil Rosen filed a 79-page derivative suit on Oct 30 in Chicago federal court alleging Alphabet's leadership knowingly trained AI models, including the Lyria music models, on copyrighted recordings, compositions, lyrics and voices.

items.title: UMG, Sony, and DistroKid tell court they are 'working on a resolution' in dispute over AI music data for Suno case
items.excerpt: The two majors are seeking data from DistroKid on how many of the tracks it delivers to streaming services are flagged as AI-generated, and the parties now say they are working toward a resolution.

items.title: GEMA on AI: 'The most important thing is we get an output remuneration'
items.excerpt: Having won an initial ruling against Suno in Germany, collecting society GEMA is weighing its next AI moves; general counsel Dr Kai Welp says getting remuneration on AI outputs, not just training, is the priority.

items.title: SkillBox has launched an AI-powered 'event creation' engine
items.excerpt: Indian live entertainment company SkillBox launched Zenith Studio, which lets organisers generate listings, descriptions, ticketing information and artwork from a single-line prompt.

items.title: What Is Attribution?
items.excerpt: An interview with Benji Rogers on AI attribution - seeing which compositions, recordings and performances shaped an AI-generated result - as a foundation for credit, consent, licensing and payment in AI music.

items.title: Music Artists Coalition File Brief in NYT v. OpenAI, Microsoft
items.excerpt: Cate Blanchett's Human Consent Foundation, joined by the Music Artists Coalition and other artist-advocacy groups, filed an amicus brief backing the New York Times in its AI-training lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft.

items.title: Suno Plows Ahead With MLC Subpoena, Sets Response Deadline
items.excerpt: Suno is pressing its subpoena against the Mechanical Licensing Collective in the UMG/Sony case, with a court-ordered response schedule; the MLC is expected to formally oppose in early November.

items.title: Meet Chat: Our In-house Studio Assistant
items.excerpt: Suno details Chat, the AI assistant built into Suno Studio that can generate stems and plugins, rename tracks, move multiple faders, insert plugin chains across a session and suggest creative directions.

items.title: Tamber 2.0 Review: 'This suite is exactly the kind of thing we've been waiting to see'
items.excerpt: MusicTech reviews Tamber 2.0, an AI suite whose assistant Tamby works inside Ableton Live 11/12 to create tracks, add plugins and arm recordings by prompt; the reviewer says the $9.99/month suite has genuine depth.

items.title: CJ ENM, 허드슨AI 더빙으로 K-댄스 북미 FAST 확장
items.excerpt: CJ ENM opened a K-dance FAST channel on LG Channels in North America, using the Hudson AI consortium's English and Spanish AI dubbing to widen its audience.

items.title: A Tutorial on Generative Models for Music Audio
items.excerpt: A monograph explaining the methods behind music audio generation - neural codecs, autoregressive and masked token models, diffusion and flow matching, sampling acceleration, preference optimization and real-time systems that play alongside musicians.

items.title: Spatial Audio Generation and Editing with Executable Plans and Self-Distilling Transfusion (AMBIT)
items.excerpt: AMBIT is a unified framework for native First-Order Ambisonics generation and editing, coupling autoregressive planning with rectified-flow rendering via executable ScenePlans that specify sources, activity and spatial placement.

items.title: Multimodal Concert Video Editing: System Design and Exploratory Evaluation
items.excerpt: A modular framework that auto-edits multi-camera concert footage by combining multitrack instrument activity, visible-instrument detection, sharpness and beat-based cut timing with probabilistic camera selection.

items.title: Kid Rock Reveals He Used AI on New Song with Eminem
items.excerpt: Kid Rock says he used AI to create part of 'Heal My Faith', his Eminem collaboration on the Christian album Halfway 2 Jesus - reportedly the gospel choir - calling AI 'another tool'.

items.title: Fans divided over 59-year-old Leon Lai's de-aged AI music video
items.excerpt: Hong Kong singer Leon Lai, 59, released a music video using AI to render him as his 19-year-old self, splitting fans over whether the de-aged look works.

items.title: Dawesome Myth 1.81: free update adds 13 new effects to the machine-learning resynthesizer plugin
items.excerpt: Dawesome's Myth, a modular-style synth plugin built on AI-supported resynthesis, gets a free 1.81 update adding 13 new effects.

items.title: Seoul Music Forum explores humanism in AI age, with one in four K-pop acts now virtual
items.excerpt: The 2026 Seoul Music Forum examined AI's rise in music, noting that one in four K-pop acts is now virtual, and debated what it means for labels.

items.title: 일본음악저작권협회, 인간이 창작한 음악 보호 위해 AI 생성곡 탐지 나서
items.excerpt: JASRAC is excluding AI-generated songs from copyright management and pursuing a detection system to identify AI-made tracks, since registrations rely on composers' self-declaration (per Asahi Shimbun, Oct 30).

items.title: 나이비, 하이엔드 음악 유통사 HREUM(흐름) 출범…AI 공동창작 음악도 듣고 판단해 유통
items.excerpt: Naibi launched HREUM, a curated distributor that accepts 'AI co-created' music made with tools like Suno, judging each track by listening before distribution.

items.title: 제이슨뮤직랩, 저작권 걱정 없는 AI 매장음악 구독 서비스 '제이슨 라운지' 출시
items.excerpt: AI music startup Jason Music Lab launched Jason Lounge, a copyright-safe AI-generated background music subscription for cafes, convenience stores, hotel lounges and gyms.

items.title: Number 1 on iTunes: AI Christian Rock Song by Fake 'Artist' Called 'Tell Me, How is Heaven?' Made on Suno
items.excerpt: A Suno-made Christian rock track credited to a non-existent artist hit No. 1 on the iTunes song chart, raising questions about AI songs exploiting grief themes on easily gamed charts.

items.title: 1위 A2O는 AI로 소통·뒤쫓는 2위는 AI곡…K팝에 인공지능 물결
items.excerpt: Chart-topping girl group A2O uses an AI fan-messaging app while an AI-made song sits at No. 2 - Yonhap surveys how AI is spreading through K-pop production and fan engagement.

items.title: '매일 20개씩 문 닫더니'…AI 날개 달고 역주행하는 中 노래방
items.excerpt: China's struggling KTV karaoke rooms are rebounding after adding AI systems - including AI-generated, often surreal on-screen visuals that replace standard music videos and have gone viral on Xiaohongshu.
